findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "discovery_report" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "lint" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: example, tools_list_report, error_conformance, discovery_report · Private data: whoami, example, discovery_report · Public sink: whoami, example, handshake_report, error_conformance · Destructive: example, handshake_report, score_card.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: example, tools_list_report, error_conformance, discovery_report · Private data: whoami, example, discovery_report · Public sink: whoami, example, handshake_report, error_conformance · Destructive: example, handshake_report, score_card

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
